notes: The staff system (NP_10 s6; NP_08 s1: a corps of 10, 3 dressed per dual). Each staffer has a role, the role's passive (live while he is dressed - two of a role dressed, both passives count) and one corner active (tactics.v1.json staff_active, per-dual charges; two dressed with the same active pool their charges, the first working his before the second). Levels come by use: every charge a staffer spends is one use in the reward ledger (rewards.staff), Lv2 at 3 uses, Lv3 at 8; Lv3 unlocks the role's second passive (NP_10 s6). Two of the five second passives are the vault's own lines (the tactician's decoy read, NP_10 s3; the hype's dual started at 10 Tension, NP_05 s1); the other three, the level thresholds, the crowd table and all ten staffers are first drafts for the content lane - the staffers are NP_10 s6's own list (retired boxers, rival cornermen, a sports-med student, the janitor who used to be somebody) with placeholder handles, not names. The crowd (NP_01 s1: crowd heat feeds corner hype actions): heat 0-100 in a dual, raised by your own spectacle only (NP_05: no Tension for damage taken), the Hype's passive +20% on every gain; Raise the Roof converts 30 heat into its +8 Tension and is refused, charge kept, below 30. The default dressed three are tactics.v1.json's equipped actives, each worked by the first staffer who carries it.
